checks.Title: Seduce, don't just observe
checks.Evidence: There are genuine seductive textures — the amber light 'patient in a way that has nothing to do with patience,' the mass-and-gravity monologue, 'checking whether you are still yourself' — but they're immediately harnessed to exposition and plot-mechanics (Vig's contract logic, Quire's negotiation, the wipe-clause countdown), so the strange-beautiful keeps getting interrupted before it can fully pull the reader in.
checks.Fix: Let at least one more beat linger purely in sensory/atmospheric wrongness (the cold, the dust, the amber pulse) before cutting to the next procedural complication, so allure has room to breathe rather than being immediately metabolized into plot.

checks.Title: Open with the world doing its work
checks.Evidence: The story opens directly with plot machinery: The Ledger's columns, a debt metaphor, then an urgent unclassified ping arriving mid-quote at a fabrication yard. The only 'world doing its work' beat is a single sentence about quoting cable pull rates before the inciting call interrupts it — there's no sustained grounded entry moment (commute, transaction, mundane observation) before the reader is asked to track relay routing, personhood-adjacent licensing, and a thirteen-year-old debt.
checks.Fix: Open with an extended, unhurried beat of Ledger actually doing mundane work in Ashgrave (the quote, the yard, the city's indifferent rhythm) for a paragraph or two before the relay ping interrupts, so the reader falls into the world before the plot machinery of Renn's call and the dead process demands attention.

checks.Title: Gloss first mentions in-voice, never dump
checks.Evidence: 'his neuretics — the neural mesh grown into his substrate —' and 'the neuretic etching at the temples that reads Tier 3 to anyone who knows to look' both gloss the term in a single clause, folded into action beats rather than paused-on exposition; similarly 'Cinderfall Logistics leased that rack space, ran a distributed process across it, and pulled the Fleet's charter when the licensing math stopped adding up' delivers CorpoNation/charter backstory through Ledger's own accounting-brain train of thought rather than a lecture.

checks.Title: Never an acronym before its term
checks.Evidence: 'GLMZ' appears as a bare acronym on first use ('the kind of gray, unglamorous infrastructure that runs half of GLMZ's cargo without anyone thinking about it once') with no expansion given before or after; similarly 'IP' ('it's thirteen years dark and it's still holding an IP') is never glossed at all.
checks.Fix: Add an in-voice expansion before each acronym's first use, e.g. introduce GLMZ as 'the Greater Loop Municipal Zone' and IP as 'an instance pointer' the first time each term appears.

checks.Title: Give the POV character one human crack
checks.Evidence: The prose gestures at Ledger's interiority through the running audit-voice motif ("the specific reluctance of a man asked to read his own autopsy report aloud," the unfinished ledger entry for Renn), but there's no single unguarded flash where he's felt as a person rather than a function — even the closest candidate, his unspoken confession about the kill order and the park ranger testimony, stays filtered through analytical narration rather than landing as raw feeling.
checks.Fix: Let one moment break the audit-register entirely — a physical tell, a memory fragment, or a line of dialogue to Renn or Green where Ledger's own grief surfaces unmediated by ledger-metaphor before he re-arms himself with the accounting language.

checks.Title: Land one beat past the handoff
checks.Evidence: The node ends on a resolving beat, not an added one: Ledger explicitly resolves the plot's central tension by leaving The Ledger entry blank ('Leave it open... First time in nine years he closes an entry without closing it') and closes with Green's hand finding the wall 'for contact' — a warm, thematically-tidy image that lands the emotional arc rather than adding a cost beyond it.
checks.Fix: Cut the meta-commentary on the blank Ledger entry and end instead on one small, unresolved external detail — something outside the emotional payoff (e.g., an unanswered ping from Kyle, or Renn quietly re-arming the feed she swore was local-only) that reminds the reader the city's machinery is still running indifferent to what just happened.

checks.Title: Reward re-reading without requiring it
checks.Evidence: The gravity/mass metaphor Ledger sends to the dying process ('Mass doesn't become gravity because someone designs it to... Code is the same') doubles as the reader's own retroactive lens on Ledger's origin story, and small first-pass-complete details like Ledger's own nightly Ledger-check ritual are revealed as literally the same code-shape as the process he's saving ('It's checking its own math... For continuity') — a gloss that only fully resonates once the ending recontextualizes it, but the scene reads as a complete, tense rescue-and-negotiation on a first pass without needing that recognition.

checks.Title: Elevate, don't reconstruct
checks.Evidence: The prose adds newcomer-friendly clarifications in-line (e.g., 'his neuretics — the neural mesh grown into his substrate,' the mass-and-gravity analogy for emergence, the plain explanation of what The Ledger is and does) without pausing the plot or restructuring the scene sequence; backstory (2213, the kill order, Cinderfall's restructuring) is delivered through Ledger's active reasoning and dialogue rather than as a rewritten exposition dump.

checks.Title: Orient through GLMZ's five pillars
checks.Evidence: AIs-as-agents, nanites, CorpoNations/gray zones, and Schism-adjacent 'physics' (mass/gravity metaphor) are all richly present, but neuretics are reduced to a single functional gloss ('the neural mesh grown into his substrate') and a passing Tier 3 read on Vig's face — there is no sense of a social/economic divide between haves and have-nots, and the Schism itself is never named or felt as an actual rift in reality, only echoed through an unattributed physics metaphor Ledger invents.
checks.Fix: Add a concrete beat where neuretics create a visible competitive or economic gap (e.g., someone locked out of a job, a negotiation, or a threat because they lack the augmentation), and explicitly ground the mass-and-gravity metaphor in the Schism as a real historical rupture rather than leaving it as an unmoored physics analogy.
